title: Surreal Eye Apocalypse
description: A surreal nightmarish landscape features a giant cracked red eye emerging from scorched earth with molten roots, a large grey alien with glowing red eyes looming in a green eclipse, two young girls with melting blue and orange faces, and a plaid blanket flowing into a massive cracked blue eye in the foreground.
prompt: Surreal apocalyptic landscape at dusk with a massive cracked blood-red eye emerging from burnt ground with glowing lava roots, a giant grey alien with huge red eyes and blue tears floating in a green eclipse behind it, two young girls with melting colorful faces and yellow patterned clothing standing on the right, a large cracked blue human eye in the bottom foreground covered by a flowing orange and blue plaid blanket, dark smokey sky, eerie and unsettling atmosphere, highly detailed digital art
